AUTHORITY NARROWING. The grant that first made the loop work was Write/Edit over .projectops/execution/** — all six of a run's records, two of which are not the worker's to hold. A run has two owners: the worker owns what it ASSERTS (its findings, its effects attestation) and ProjectOS owns what it STATES and OBSERVES (the brief it is judged against, the session record naming who owns the run, the evidence collected about it). The grant is now exactly four patterns over *.findings.json and *.effects.json. `toolGrantProblems` refuses any write-capable grant outside that closed list when the config is READ, before anything can spawn, and Bash, Task and Agent are on the same list because a shell grant is a write grant under another name. What that check cannot do is stated rather than implied: it governs what this CONFIG may grant, not the CLI's defaults or a user's settings files.
